rationale: The working evaluation identified the unfocused cross-industry beachhead and dependence on unsigned reservation and resale rights as the concentrated limiter. The redesign replaces the speculative reserved-capacity spread with a single-vertical recurring compliance workflow: a small pre-mapped laboratory panel, annual calendar, custody process, transparent pass-through, and reservations only after observed paid volume. This changes the customer, paid event, offer, distribution, compounding mechanism, commercial archetype, control point, critical dependency, and every structured economics field. It does not assert a winning test family, partner rights, prices, margins, conversions, retention, or validation; those remain explicit hypotheses and unknowns.
